structured_summary: The robot provides instructional guidelines to a human in a collaborative workspace. While the human is speaking, the robot must remain silent and not interrupt. After the human finishes speaking, the robot is allowed to respond.

obligations.source_sentence: When the human is speaking, the robot must not interrupt.
The robot may respond only after the human has finished speaking.

missing_details: Exact definition of 'finished speaking' (e.g., required silence duration)
Modalities allowed for robot response (speech, gesture, etc.)
Precise spatial bounds of the collaborative workspace
Threshold for what counts as an interruption (overlap length)
potential_ambiguities: Whether brief pauses in human speech count as 'finished speaking'
Whether non-verbal robot behavior (e.g., movement) counts as interrupting
If the robot's initial instructional guidelines count as a separate speaking event that must also follow turn-taking rules
